featured_reviews.name: KB Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
A South Indian Hindu temple/Ayyappa shrine on the serene hillside of Shreenagar/ Shantinagar at Wagle Estate, Thane. During the early 1970s, a few devotees of swamy Ayyappan joined together for prayers and from there the movement started growing until 1977 when the Samiti was registered as a trust and thereafter it continued to spread, grow and attract adherents.

Lots of steps to get to the very top as the temple is located on a slope, Once on top one can get excellent views of some areas of Mumbai which is both beautiful and pleasing. Many people use the open area on top for Yoga, massage therapy or martial arts. The garden seems to be well maintained by the temple. The area appeared clean and many people came in to offer prayers during the time I was there. The temple opens early morning at 5am and closes at 9pm.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Sri Ayyappa Swamy Temple in Sai Baba Nagar, Borivali West, is a शांत और पवित्र place that offers a deeply spiritual experience. The temple is well maintained and has a calm, positive atmosphere that helps devotees feel peaceful as soon as they enter. The Ayyappa Swamy idol is beautifully adorned, and the daily poojas and bhajans are conducted with great devotion and discipline. During special occasions like Mandala Pooja and Makara Sankranti, the temple becomes especially vibrant while still remaining well organized. The priests and volunteers are polite and helpful, making devotees feel welcome.

Overall, it is a wonderful place for prayer, meditation, and finding inner peace, especially for Ayyappa devotees and residents nearby.

featured_reviews.name: Rudra Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited this beautiful Ganpati temple and the experience was honestly unforgettable. The moment you enter the temple परिसर, you feel a very peaceful and positive vibe. The temple is surrounded by such calm and natural beauty that it immediately relaxes your mind. One of the best and most unique parts of this place is the lake beside the temple. The lake makes the entire atmosphere look magical and peaceful, especially during the evening time when the weather becomes cool and the reflection of the temple lights falls on the water. Watching the ducks swimming in the lake adds such a wholesome and soothing feeling to the whole experience. It feels like a perfect combination of spirituality and nature together.
Another thing I really loved is that one more mandir is connected to the main Ganpati temple, which makes the visit even more special. You can peacefully walk from one mandir to another and take blessings at both places together. The architecture and surroundings of both temples are very beautiful and give such positive energy. The entire place is well-maintained, clean, and perfect for families, friends, or even people who just want some peaceful alone time away from the city noise.
The atmosphere here feels very divine and calming. Sitting near the lake for a few minutes after darshan feels extremely relaxing and refreshing. The sound of birds, the peaceful water, and the spiritual environment together create such a different and memorable experience. This is not just a temple but a place where you can genuinely feel peace and positivity.
I would highly recommend everyone to visit this place at least once. Whether you are going for darshan, photography, family time, or just mental peace, this place is perfect in every way. A truly beautiful and serene Ganpati temple experience that stays in your heart even after leaving the place.

featured_reviews.name: yogesh pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: Swayambhu Shree Ganesh Temple is a very peaceful and positive place for darshan—clean premises, calm atmosphere, and overall good management; it’s also easy to reach from Borivali West and feels like a perfect spiritual stop in Mumbai, but one important thing to note is that camera/photography is not allowed inside the temple premises, so please don’t plan to shoot photos or videos during darshan and follow the rules to avoid any issue. featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Mirashi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting Vazira Ganesh Temple was a profoundly enriching experience. Located in a tranquil corner of the city, this temple serves as a serene oasis, providing a perfect escape from the hectic pace of everyday life.

One of the standout features of Vazira Ganesh Temple is its immaculate maintenance and peaceful ambiance. The temple grounds are meticulously kept, contributing to a serene atmosphere conducive to spiritual contemplation. The architecture is stunning, adorned with intricate carvings that reflect a rich cultural heritage. The vibrant idol of Lord Ganesha is the centerpiece, radiating a palpable sense of divinity and peace.

Overall, my visit to Vazira Ganesh Temple left a lasting impression. It's not just a place of worship but a sanctuary where one can reconnect with spirituality amidst a beautifully preserved environment.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Mirashi
featured_reviews.review_text:
**Shri Swami Samarth Temple, Borivali West, Mumbai**

Nestled in the heart of Borivali West, Mumbai, Shri Swami Samarth Temple is a hidden gem dedicated to Swami Samarth Maharaj. Despite its modest size, this temple exudes a serene and peaceful atmosphere, making it a cherished spot for meditation and spiritual contemplation.

The cleanliness and well-maintained surroundings of the temple are truly commendable. It provides a tranquil environment that enhances the spiritual experience for visitors. Accessibility is also convenient, with several bus and metro options nearby, ensuring easy travel for devotees.

One of the highlights of visiting this temple is the availability of traditional offerings like Puran Poli and Modak, which adds to the authenticity of the spiritual journey.

While the temple lacks a dedicated parking area, its popularity among devotees seeking a quiet and devotional experience remains unwavering.

Overall, Shri Swami Samarth Temple offers a serene haven in bustling Borivali West, where one can connect deeply with spirituality amidst peaceful surroundings.

LIC Shiv Mandir in LIC Colony, Borivali West, is a peaceful and spiritually calming place tucked away inside a quiet residential area. It’s small in size but has a strong positive vibe, especially during early mornings and evenings.

The temple is well maintained and mainly visited by local residents. Lord Shiva is the main deity here, and there are regular aartis and small poojas, especially on Mondays and during Shravan month. It’s not a touristy spot, but more of a local spiritual corner for regular devotees.

Pros:

Very peaceful and quiet atmosphere

Clean and simple temple premises

Friendly and respectful locals

Cons:

No dedicated parking space nearby

Can get crowded during special occasions or festivals

Overall, it’s a good place to sit for a few minutes, pray, and disconnect from daily stress. If you're nearby or living in LIC Colony, this mandir definitely adds to the calmness of the area.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Mota Ambaji Temple in Borivali East is a very peaceful and divine place for devotees of Maa Amba. The temple has a beautiful idol of Maa Ambaji, and the atmosphere inside the temple is very calm and spiritually uplifting.

featured_reviews.name: Traveller
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mota Ambaji Temple in Borivali East is a highly revered shrine dedicated to Maa Amba (Ambaji), a powerful form of Goddess Durga worshipped for strength, protection, and fulfillment of wishes. This temple holds deep faith among devotees, especially those with roots connected to Gujarat and Rajasthan, where Ambaji worship has strong cultural significance.

According to Puranic beliefs, Maa Amba is considered a manifestation of Adi Shakti, the supreme cosmic energy. She is associated with the legend of the Samudra Manthan, where divine energies emerged to restore balance in the universe. Devotees believe that Maa Amba blesses her followers with courage and removes obstacles from their lives. Many also connect her to the Devi Mahatmya, where the Goddess destroys evil forces to protect righteousness.

The temple is known for its vibrant and energetic atmosphere, especially during festivals like Navratri, when it becomes a center of devotion, bhajans, and cultural celebrations. Despite being located in a busy part of Mumbai, the temple offers a sense of peace and spiritual grounding once inside.

The premises are well-maintained, and darshan is generally smooth, though it can get crowded during peak hours and auspicious days. Devotees often visit to seek blessings for prosperity, success, and family well-being.

Overall experience: A spiritually powerful and culturally rich temple, offering a perfect blend of devotion, tradition, and divine energy in the heart of Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Tours “Dipeash J Somaiya”
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Sacred Birthday Pilgrimage to Mota Ambaji Temple

On October 28th, 2024, we embarked on a truly special pilgrimage to the Mota Ambaji Temple to celebrate Ms. Phalguni D. Somaiya's birthday.  The experience transcended a simple visit; it was a deeply moving and spiritual journey.

The atmosphere at the temple was one of profound peace and serenity.  The air hummed with a quiet energy, a palpable sense of devotion emanating from the countless devotees gathered there.  The sheer scale of the temple, its intricate architecture, and the vibrant colors were breathtaking.  It felt as if the very stones held a history of faith and devotion.

Witnessing the unwavering faith of the pilgrims, their quiet prayers, and the shared sense of community, was incredibly humbling.  It was a powerful reminder of the unifying force of spirituality and the enduring power of belief.  Even the bustling energy of the crowds seemed to contribute to the overall sense of reverence.

We lit a lamp for Phalguni's birthday, a small act that felt significant in the vastness of the temple's sacred space.  The whole experience was profoundly moving and felt like a perfect way to celebrate her special day.  Mota Ambaji Temple is more than just a place of worship; it's a place that touches your soul. We left feeling renewed, inspired, and deeply grateful for the opportunity to experience its sanctity.

The ambience is serene, and the aartis are truly mesmerizing — the sound of bells and chants instantly brings a sense of devotion and peace. The idol of Maa Ambaji is adorned gracefully, radiating powerful vibrations that make you feel blessed.
